why: Source: four statement checks (share four years ago by sum and divide, past growth against the rest, three-times pace, 20-year projection by growth factors) about 9 steps; question: the same four statement types with the same calculations, about 9 steps; only the position of the valid statement differs.
Source: sum the indirect segments, apply the percentage to 2013 GDP (2 steps, trap of using totals); question: the same sum and multiplication with the same trap (2 steps).
Source: pick the right pie, sum scores 1 to 3, multiply by the respondent share (3 steps); question: pick the right pie among four, sum scores 1 to 3, multiply by the respondent share (3 steps).

Source: four checks (sum revenue, compare two losses, costs from negative margin for highest year, costs for one year) about 7 steps; question: the same four check types with the same cost-from-margin reasoning, about 7 steps.
Source: four profit-per-product divisions then a ranking (2 steps); question: four profit-per-model divisions then a ranking (2 steps), with the same paired equal counts.

Source: five revenue-per-transaction divisions and a ranking, ignoring the one-year-value chart (3 steps); question: five revenue-per-order divisions and a ranking, ignoring the same distractor chart (3 steps).

Source: units per order, threshold check, per-litre to per-tube conversion for two sizes, two order values, average (about 6 steps); question: bottles per order, threshold check, per-litre to per-bottle conversion for two sizes, two order values, average (about 6 steps).

Source: read unlabelled scatter points, recognise margin as profit per sales, a ratio check, a highest-margin check, and the missing-market-size trap for two statements (about 5 steps); question: the same readings, ratio check, highest-margin check and market-size trap (about 5 steps).
Source: two profits, two per-item divisions, percentage change (5 steps); question: two profits, two per-repair divisions, percentage change (5 steps).

Source: total cost from fixed plus variable, difference cumulative shares for each group, divide by group count across four statements (about 6 steps); question: the identical structure with fixed plus per-claim cost, cumulative differencing and per-landlord division (about 6 steps).
